summary: Fusemachines Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with affiliates of Meteora Capital Partners. The company issued a $2.5 million original principal amount convertible note (18% OID) for $2.05 million, plus a warrant to buy 2.05 million shares at $4.20 per share. The note converts at a fixed $4.20/share with no variable pricing. Concurrent amendments to existing forward purchase and shortfall warrant agreements were executed. A resale registration statement is required. This is a financing transaction, not a classic special situation; typical risk-arb angle absent. Watch for dilution and registration effectiveness.
